cells.gaps: The source does not say whether Siraj's pupil registration is a pilot or live, who keys the entries (the school or the parent), which level it covers or how many schools use it. No plan or finance is stated. MRT-001 is from the excluded source and sets nothing.
cells.note: Pupil registration through Siraj opened on 28 September 2026, level not named and so read as primary; the source does not call it live, so it is read as a pilot, stage 2. Stage 3 needs a learner register that schools fill past its pilot, and neither the schools' entry nor the end of the pilot is stated.
